question: What is the algorithm used to create word embeddings?
title: Shared Task: Lexical Semantic Change Detection in German
answer_rationale: Multiple documents reference SGNS as the underlying algorithm for creating word embeddings. Text 9 states that most teams use SGNS based on BIBREF13 to learn semantic spaces, and Text 10 identifies SGNS + OP + CD as the overall best-performing model, confirming SGNS as the core embedding algorithm.
